question.worked_solution:
We start with the ratio $7:2$ and write it as a fraction:

$$
\frac{7}{2}
$$

So the numerator represents the left-hand entry ($7$), and the denominator represents the right-hand entry ($2$).

We can generate equivalent ratios by finding equivalent fractions:

- To create a denominator of $6,$ we multiply the numerator and denominator of our fraction by $3:$

$$
\frac{7\times 3}{2\times 3}=\frac{21}{6}
$$

- To create a denominator of $20,$ we multiply the numerator and denominator of our fraction by $10:$

$$
\frac{7\times 10}{2\times 10}=\frac{70}{20}
$$

Finally, we fill in the ratio table:

| $7$ | $2$ |
| --- | --- |
| $21$ | $6$ |
| $70$ | $20$ |

$$

$$
